origin.osm: way 128230182 (historic=monument, tourism=artwork, building=yes, «Monument a Francesc Macià», artist_name Josep Maria Subirachs, wikidata Q13405928), centroid of its 4 nodes

note: Local metres, +x east +y north, from OpenStreetMap (ODbL) via the OSM API on 2026-10-01 (equirectangular around the origin). Heights are ICGC Barcelona mesh heights (ellipsoidal, raw), measured with tools/icgc_ground.py.

ground_measurements.paving_slope: The paving rises northwards across the monument: about +0.03 m at y = -4 and +0.87 m at y = +5 above RAW0 (minimum mesh heights in 1 m cells), modelled as z = 0.31 + 0.093 (y + 1)

osm_footprint_local.reading: Axis-aligned 3.6 x 6.0 m outline; it matches the mesh's top-down extent of the inverted staircase (mesh corners at about 9.1-9.4 m: (-2, 3), (2, 3), (-1.5, -3.5), (2, -3.5)), so it is read as the aerial outline of the cantilevered stair, not the pedestal's base

mesh_solid_core_local.reading: Cells whose minimum mesh height is well above the paving: the pedestal. Under the south overhang (y -1 to -2.5) the mesh reaches the paving (0.3-0.4 m), so the pedestal does not extend there

orientation.source: OSM way 128230182 is drawn north-aligned; inscription face to the south (towards La Rambla, Wikipedia ca «enfront de la Rambla»), stair rising and cantilevering southwards, concrete side wall on the east (photos on Wikimedia Commons «Category:Monument a Francesc Macià (Barcelona)», mesh asymmetry: tall surfaces at x = +2)

reflecting_pool.note: Pool by Helio Piñón and Albert Viaplana; not modelled

la_deessa.note: Stands in the pool; not modelled

metro_L3_Catalunya.note: The station runs directly under the monument: its foundation bears on the station structure (load path not documented)

facts.pedestal: Travertine, a succession of stone blocks in broken bond (Wikipedia ca)
facts.stair: Concrete inverted staircase; the first three steps are set into the pedestal (Macià's three years as President), the rest end abruptly, unfinished (the country's future)
facts.inscription: «CATALUNYA A FRANCESC MACIÀ» in large letters at the top of the pedestal's front
facts.back: Iron coat of arms of Catalonia and a sentence of Macià's to the Catalan deputies of 14 December 1932
facts.bust: Separate monolith in front of the monument with a bronze bust of Macià, replica of the portrait by Josep Clarà (1932)
facts.wikidata: Q13405928; P8601 Barcelona public-art id 2048-1; P12802 poblesdecatalunya.cat id 2736; P2043 length '795 metre' (implausible unit, not used)
facts.railing: None visible in any photograph: not modelled
facts.lighting: No fixture documented in OSM or the photographs; the three in-ground uplights in the model are illustrative

steps.count_source: Counted on Commons photographs (8-9 nosings visible); 9 chosen: 3 set into the pedestal + 6 above it
